create_camera_helper: create a CameraHelper instance with hitl_config and gui_input to manage camera controls
update_camera_position: call update on CameraHelper with base_pos and dt to process zoom and rotation inputs
get_camera_transform: call get_cam_transform on CameraHelper to retrieve the current Magnum Matrix4 camera transform
get_forward_vectors: call get_xz_forward or get_cam_forward_vector to get the camera forward direction
get_eye_and_lookat_positions: call get_eye_pos and get_lookat_pos to retrieve the camera eye and look-at positions
